_comment: Human-verified place corrections. SOURCE data, not derived — tracked in git, unlike jakarta/content/extracted/. Each row overrides a geocode by place_key. Every entry cites where the coordinate came from; an entry without a source is not allowed. See place-overrides.md for the research trail.

_schema.name: human readability only
_schema.sources: >=1 URL or osm: ref for any override

name: Hotel Tugu Bali
note: SOURCE ADDRESS IS WRONG. venues.jsonl says 'Jalan Pantai Berawa'; the hotel is on Jl. Pantai Batu Bolong No.117x, Canggu — a different street. That wrong street is what collapsed it onto Finns. OSM and the hotel's own listing (8deg39'29.88"S 115deg7'49.8"E) agree to ~30m.

name: Finns Recreation Club
note: Jl. Pantai Berawa No.15, Canggu — the source address was right here; only the geocode was coarse. Not in OSM under this name.

name: Trans Resort Bali
note: NOT A GEOCODING ERROR — a dedup miss. 'Trans Resort Bali' and 'The Trans Resort Bali' are one hotel; dedupe.py keys on normalize_name, which does not strip a leading 'The'. They share a point because they ARE the same place.

name: The Trans Resort Bali
note: Exact-name match in OSM. Surviving row of the merge.

name: The Legian Seminyak Bali
note: Exact-name match in OSM as 'The Legian Bali'. Previous street point was only ~60m off — the mildest error in this set.

name: Red Carpet
note: Full name is Red Carpet Champagne Bar, Jl. Kayu Aya No.42. Two independent sources agree to ~10m. I initially doubted this because Kayu Aya's west end sits near 115.153; the agreement settles it.

name: Anantara Seminyak
sources: osm:way/Grand Seminyak - Lifestyle Boutique Bali Resort
note: REBRANDED. Anantara Seminyak is now 'Grand Seminyak - Lifestyle Boutique Bali Resort' (Accor), which is why no search for the old name resolved. OSM files it on Jalan Camplung Tanduk; listings say Jl. Abimanyu (Dhyana Pura) — adjacent streets in the same block. 0.85 not 0.90 for that discrepancy.

name: Opera Bali
note: OSM has an amenity=nightclub named lowercase 'opera' near Camplung Tanduk. Corroborated indirectly: Anantara/Grand Seminyak listings describe the resort as 'within 10 minutes walk of opera Club'. Confidence 0.75 — the OSM name is a single generic token, so this is the weakest identification in the set. Worth an editor's eye.

name: Salon Bali
note: UNRESOLVED, deliberately. Jalan Camplung Tanduk No.10, Seminyak. Not in OSM under any variant tried; no web source gives a venue-level coordinate. A small salon that may no longer trade. action=drop means 'remove the wrong shared point', NOT 'delete the row' — better unresolved than guessed.

name: The Great 50 Show - Bali
note: NOT A VENUE AT ALL. Oriental Circus Indonesia's 50th-anniversary show — a temporary run from 1 May to 25 Aug 2019 on Sunset Road near Simpang Dewa Ruci. An expired event extracted as a place. Should carry no coordinate, and arguably should not be in places; flag for editorial.

name: The Mill at Starbucks Reserve Dewata
note: Jl. Sunset Road No.77 — matches the source address exactly. OSM has the node as plain 'Starbucks', so the name-agreement gate rejects it automatically (1/3 token overlap); this override is how it gets in. 'The Mill' is a venue inside Starbucks Reserve Dewata, so the shared building point is right. 0.80: correct building, not a distinct interior point.

name: Discovery Kartika Plaza Hotel
note: Exact-name match in OSM. Distinct from The Anvaya next door — the two were collapsed onto one Jalan Kartika Plaza street point; ~280m apart is the real separation.

name: The Anvaya Becah Resort Bali
note: NAME TYPO IN SOURCE: 'Becah' should be 'Beach' — The Anvaya Beach Resort Bali. OSM has it as 'The ANVAYA Hotel'. Worth fixing in venues.jsonl too, since the typo would defeat any future name match.

name: Ayodya Resort Bali
note: ALREADY CORRECT — existing coordinate matches OSM's exact-name match precisely. Recorded only to raise confidence from 0.50 and to document that its duplicate_centroid flag is a FALSE POSITIVE.

name: Ayodya Beach Club
note: FALSE-POSITIVE DUPLICATE. Ayodya Beach Club & Grill is a beachfront restaurant INSIDE Ayodya Resort Bali. Sharing the resort's coordinate is correct, not an error — the duplicate_centroid gate cannot tell genuine co-location from a geocoder collapse. Keeping the shared point deliberately.
